description:
This Amendment to RFQ 36C26226Q0415 is intended to:

  1. Clarify Delivery Distribution:

(4) CD burners will be delivered to the main facility, 650 E. Indian School Rd., Phoenix, AZ. The facility will deliver the CD burners to their locations.

(2) CD burners will be delivered to the 32nd street clinic, 400 N. 32nd St., Phoenix AZ.

 However, there will be 2 CD burners at each location listed in SOW. The contractor will go to all three sites to configure the CD burners and train the staff.

  1. Correct the Product Service Code (PSC):

Previous PSC code 7E20

Correct PSC code 5836

Submit written offers with spec-sheets of proposed items in accordance with the following instructions, as well as Addendum to FAR 52.212-1, Instruction to Offerors. Oral offers will not be accepted. Complete and submit enclosure 1 via email no later than, Friday, March 06, 2026, by 12:00PM PST, to israel.garcia2@va.gov.

There are no other changes to the terms and conditions of this Solicitation.

All other terms and conditions remain in full force and effect.
